title: Rename the panda rival (cosmetic, within the animal-trader cast)
problem: 'Panda Lim' pairs a Chinese surname with a panda, which may read as an ethnic association. The owner agreed to rename it while keeping the cast coherent.

approval.evidence: Approve PLAN-006 only, including its listed tests and documentation, name: Patches

scope: Change the panda rival's display name in src/engine/data.ts to the owner's chosen nickname; picture, lines and difficulty unchanged
Update the daily-challenge line in RULES.md
Keep 'Panda Lim' reserved so no player can take the old rival name
Unit tests: old saves naming 'Panda Lim' still get the panda's reaction lines; the daily-challenge score check gives the same result
exclusions: Other renames (Kumar the Genie reviewed: keep for now)
Art, lines, rules, AI or balance
Changing names inside games already in progress or saved

acceptance.text: New solo games, daily challenges and online rooms show the new name
acceptance.evidence: tests/rename.test.ts: the panda rival is "Patches"; no "Panda Lim" in the rival list; the daily challenge lineup includes Patches. Online rooms draw names from the same list

acceptance.text: A saved game from before the rename loads, still shows 'Panda Lim', and the panda's lines still appear (test)
acceptance.evidence: tests/rename.test.ts: a game saved with "Panda Lim" loads unchanged and keeps the old name; the panda's undercut line is still chosen (lines are matched by picture)

acceptance.text: Daily-challenge verification gives the same score for the same moves (test)
acceptance.evidence: tests/rename.test.ts: the same daily challenge played with either name ends with identical cash and sales for every shop

acceptance.text: Both 'Panda Lim' and the new name are refused as player names (test)
acceptance.evidence: tests/rename.test.ts: "Patches", "Panda Lim" and "panda lim" are refused as player names

acceptance.text: verify:full green in CI; no rule, save-format or server-logic changes
acceptance.evidence: CI run 15 (40338476298) on f14245a green: 68 unit tests and the full browser suite

changed: The panda rival is now called Patches; old name kept reserved

playerNotes: The panda trader is now called Patches
